title: Adventures of Pebbles
description: The poetry, stories and reflections of Pebbles Martinez — a teenage writer and future architect who writes because she loves to write.

author.name: Pebbles Martinez
author.bio: Hi, my name is Pebbles Martinez. I am a girl who wants to contribute my best to world. My dream is to become an architect and an author of books. I write articles about my adventures as a teenager. I write because I want to share my ideas to people, and simply because I love writing. In my blog, you will be able to read random ideas that make me happy. Join my articles and let us be jolly!

Poetry.blurb: Verses about the sea, the sun, the family and the self.

Reflections.blurb: Thinking out loud about focus, fear, mistakes and growing up.

Stories.blurb: Little narratives with big feelings inside them.

Letters.blurb: Notes written in the voice of someone else — the Earth, a dog, a feeling.

Guides.blurb: Friendly how-tos: drawing, deciding, procrastinating less.
